name: US Multi-State Privacy Compliance (CCPA/CPRA, VCDPA, CPA)
description: Comprehensive compliance framework for US state data privacy statutes (California CCPA/CPRA, Virginia VCDPA, Colorado CPA, Connecticut CTDPA, Utah UCPA, Texas, Oregon, etc.), covering GPC signals, 'Do Not Sell/Share', Sensitive Data Opt-In, and Universal Deletion.
owner: US Privacy Compliance & State Regulatory Office

checklists.name: US Multi-State Privacy Compliance Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for California CCPA/CPRA, VCDPA, CPA, CTDPA, UCPA, and state breach notification requirements.

items.statement: Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals sent by browser user agents automatically opt-out users from sale/sharing of personal data.
Clear web notice 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' and 'Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information' are rendered.
Explicit opt-in consent is obtained prior to collecting Sensitive Personal Data (geolocation, biometrics, health, ethnicity) in VCDPA/CPA states.
Consumer privacy request workflow processes Access, Deletion, and Correction requests within 45 calendar days.
State breach notification mechanisms guarantee reporting to state Attorneys General within statutory timelines (e.g. 15-45 days).

reviewGates.name: US State Privacy Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The US Privacy Counsel attests that GPC signal handling, sensitive data opt-ins, and state DSAR workflows satisfy CCPA/CPRA, VCDPA, and state statutes.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the privacy audit evidence confirm full compliance with US multi-state privacy laws?
